title: Answer: intelligence is the capacity to gather evidence for a model of the sensed world

statements.text: Active inference defines intelligence operationally as self-evidencing: the capacity to accumulate evidence for a generative model of one's sensed world, which is the capacity of a system to generate evidence for its own existence. Intelligence on this definition is perspectival, since it makes sense of the world from a given set of beliefs. It does not imply consciousness: a sentient intelligent system in this sense need not have qualitative states of awareness.
statements.scope: Designing ecosystems of intelligence from first principles (2022)
